1.en: Tā sīn mīm God knows best what He means by these letters.
1.ar:
سُورَة الشُّعَراء [ مَكِّيَّة إلّا آيَة ١٩٧ و٢٢٤ إلى آخِر السُّورَة فَمَدَنِيَّة وآياتها ٢٢٧ آيَة نَزَلَتْ بَعْد الواقِعَة ]

﴿طسم﴾ اللَّه أعْلَم بِمُرادِهِ بِذَلِكَ

2.en: Those namely these signs are the signs of the Manifest Book the Qur’ān the genitive annexation āyātu’l-kitābi conveys the partitive meaning of min the Manifest meaning the one that manifests what is truth from what is falsehood.
2.ar: ﴿تِلْكَ﴾ أيْ هَذِهِ الآيات ﴿آيات الكِتاب﴾ القُرْآن والإضافَة بِمَعْنى مِن ﴿المُبِين﴾ المُظْهِر الحَقّ مِن الباطِل

3.en: Perhaps O Muhammad (s) you might kill yourself out of distress for the reason that they namely the people of Mecca will not become believers la‘alla here expresses sympathy in other words what is meant is ‘have pity on it your self by alleviating the burden of this distress’.
3.ar: ﴿لَعَلَّك﴾ يا مُحَمَّد ﴿باخِع نَفْسك﴾ قاتِلْها غَمًّا مِن أجْل ﴿ألّا يَكُونُوا﴾ أيْ أهْل مَكَّة ﴿مُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ ولَعَلَّ هُنا لِلْإشْفاقِ أيْ أشْفَقَ عَلَيْها بِتَخْفِيفِ هَذا الغَمّ

4.en: If We will We will send down to them a sign from the heaven before which their necks will remain fa-zallat although grammatically in the past tense is being used in the sense of the imperfect tense bowed in humility and they will believe since ‘necks’ are described as ‘bowed in humility’ a status which in fact refers to those who possess them the adjectival form khādi‘ūn ‘bowed in humility’ used therein is the one normally used for rational beings.
4.ar: ﴿إنْ نَشَأْ نُنَزِّل عَلَيْهِمْ مِن السَّماء آيَة فَظَلَّتْ﴾ بِمَعْنى المُضارِع: أيْ تَظَلّ، أيْ تَدُوم ﴿أعْناقهمْ لَها خاضِعِينَ﴾ فَيُؤْمِنُونَ، ولِما وصَفَتْ الأَعْناق بِالخُضُوعِ الَّذِي هُوَ لِأَرْبابِها جُمِعَتْ الصِّفَة مِنهُ جَمْع العُقَلاء

5.en: And there would never come to them from the Compassionate One any remembrance any revelation from the Qur’ān that is new muhdathin is an explicative adjective but that they used to disregard it.
5.ar: ﴿وما يَأْتِيهِمْ مِن ذِكْر﴾ قُرْآن ﴿مِن الرَّحْمَن مُحْدَث﴾ صِفَة كاشِفَة

6.en: Verily then they have denied it; but soon there will come to them the news the consequences of that which they used to deride.

7.en: Have they not contemplated observed the earth how many We have caused to grow therein in other words We have caused to grow therein many of every splendid kind of vegetation of every fair species.
7.ar: ﴿أوَلَمْ يَرَوْا﴾ يَنْظُرُوا ﴿إلى الأَرْض كَمْ أنْبَتْنا فِيها﴾ أيْ كَثِيرًا ﴿مِن كُلّ زَوْج كَرِيم﴾ نَوْع حَسَن

8.en: Surely in that there is a sign an indication of the perfection of His power exalted be He; but most of them in God’s knowledge are not believers kāna here according to Sībawayhi is extra.
8.ar: ﴿إنّ فِي ذَلِك لَآيَة﴾ دَلالَة عَلى كَمال قُدْرَته تَعالى ﴿وما كانَ أكْثَرهمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ فِي عِلْم اللَّه، وكانَ قالَ سِيبَوَيْهِ: زائِدَة

9.en: And surely your Lord He is the Mighty One Who will exact vengeance from the disbelievers the Merciful Who shows mercy to believers.
9.ar: ﴿وإنَّ رَبّك لَهُوَ العَزِيز﴾ ذُو العِزَّة يَنْتَقِم مِن الكافِرِينَ ﴿الرَّحِيم﴾ يَرْحَم المُؤْمِنِينَ

10.en: And mention O Muhammad (s) to your people when your Lord called to Moses on the night he saw the fire and the bush saying ‘Go to the wrongdoing folk as a messenger
10.ar: ﴿و﴾ واذْكُرْ ﴿إذْ نادى رَبّك مُوسى﴾ لَيْلَة رَأى النّار والشَّجَرَة ﴿أنْ﴾ أيْ: بِأَنْ ﴿ائْتِ القَوْم الظّالِمِينَ﴾ رَسُولًا

11.en: Pharaoh’s folk to them as well as him — they wronged their souls by disbelieving in God and wronged the Children of Israel by enslaving them — Will they not a-lā the hamza indicates a negation meant as a rebuke show fear?’ of God by being obedient to Him and affirm His Oneness?
11.ar: ﴿قَوْم فِرْعَوْن﴾ مَعَهُ ظَلَمُوا أنْفُسهمْ بِالكُفْرِ بِاللَّهِ وبَنِي إسْرائِيل بِاسْتِعْبادِهِمْ ﴿ألا﴾ الهَمْزَة لِلِاسْتِفْهامِ الإنْكارِيّ ﴿يَتَّقُونَ﴾ اللَّه بِطاعَتِهِ فَيُوَحِّدُونَهُ

12.en: He Moses said ‘My Lord I fear they will deny me

13.en: and that anguish will constrain my breast because of their denial of me and that my tongue will not utter clearly to deliver the Message because of the knot in it. So give the Mission to my brother Aaron alongside me.
13.ar: ﴿ويَضِيق صَدْرِي﴾ مِن تَكْذِيبهمْ لِي ﴿ولا يَنْطَلِق لِسانِي﴾ بِأَداءِ الرِّسالَة لِلْعُقْدَةِ الَّتِي فِيهِ ﴿فَأَرْسِلْ إلى﴾ أخِي ﴿هارُونَ﴾ مَعِي

14.en: And I have sinned against them by my slaying of the Egyptian man and I fear they will slay me’ for this.
14.ar: ﴿ولَهُمْ عَلَيَّ ذَنْب﴾ بِقَتْلِ القِبْطِيّ مِنهُمْ ﴿فَأَخاف أنْ يَقْتُلُونِي﴾ بِهِ

15.en: Said He exalted be He ‘Certainly not! they shall not slay you. Go both of you you and your brother — this address although in the dual form is predominantly for the person present as opposed to the absent one — with Our signs. We will indeed be with you hearing what you say and what is said to you ma‘akum the two Moses and Aaron are referred to here with the plural pronoun.
15.ar: ﴿قالَ﴾ تَعالى ﴿كَلّا﴾ لا يَقْتُلُونَك ﴿فاذْهَبا﴾ أيْ أنْتَ وأَخُوك، فَفِيهِ تَغْلِيب الحاضِر عَلى الغائِب ﴿بِآياتِنا إنّا مَعَكُمْ مُسْتَمِعُونَ﴾ ما تَقُولُونَ وما يُقال لَكُمْ، أُجْرِيا مَجْرى الجَماعَة

16.en: So the two of you approach Pharaoh and say “Indeed We are — indeed each of the two of us is the Messenger of the Lord of the Worlds to you
16.ar: ﴿فَأْتِيا فِرْعَوْن فَقُولا إنّا﴾ كُلًّا مِنّا ﴿رَسُول رَبّ العالَمِينَ﴾ إلَيْك

17.en: that you should let go forth with us to Syria the Children of Israel” ’. So they approached him and said to him that which has been mentioned.
17.ar: ﴿أنْ﴾ أيْ: بِأَنْ ﴿أرْسِلْ مَعَنا﴾ إلى الشّام ﴿بَنِي إسْرائِيل﴾ فَأْتِياهُ فَقالا لَهُ ما ذُكِرَ

18.en: He Pharaoh said to Moses ‘Did we not rear you among us in our homes as a child? as an infant only recently born but weaned and did you not stay with us for years of your life? for thirty years — he would dress from Pharaoh’s clothes and ride chariots of his and was referred to as Pharaoh’s son.
18.ar: ﴿قالَ﴾ فِرْعَوْن لِمُوسى ﴿ألَمْ نُرَبِّك فِينا﴾ فِي مَنازِلنا ﴿ولِيدًا﴾ صَغِيرًا قَرِيبًا مِن الوِلادَة بَعْد فِطامه ﴿ولَبِثْت فِينا مِن عُمُرك سِنِينَ﴾ ثَلاثِينَ سَنَة يَلْبَس مِن مَلابِس فِرْعَوْن ويَرْكَب مِن مَراكِبه وكانَ يُسَمّى ابْنه

19.en: And you committed that deed of yours — namely his slaying of the Egyptian — being an ingrate’ a denier of my favours to you in having reared you among us and not enslaved you.
19.ar: ﴿وفَعَلْت فَعْلَتَك الَّتِي فَعَلْت﴾ هِيَ قَتْله القِبْطِيّ ﴿وأَنْتَ مِن الكافِرِينَ﴾ الجاحِدِينَ لِنِعْمَتِي عَلَيْك بِالتَّرْبِيَةِ وعَدَم الِاسْتِعْباد

20.en: He Moses said ‘I did that then when I was astray from the knowledge and the Message which God would later give me.
20.ar: ﴿قالَ﴾ مُوسى ﴿فَعَلْتها إذًا﴾ أيْ حِينَئِذٍ ﴿وأَنا مِن الضّالِّينَ﴾ عَمًّا آتانِي اللَّه بَعْدها مِن العِلْم والرِّسالَة

21.en: So I fled from you as I was afraid of you. Then my Lord gave me judgement knowledge and made me one of the messengers.
21.ar: ﴿فَفَرَرْت مِنكُمْ لَمّا خِفْتُكُمْ فَوَهَبَ لِي رَبِّي حُكْمًا﴾ عِلْمًا

22.en: That is a favour with which you now reproach me that you have enslaved the Children of Israel’ an ‘abbadta banī Isrā’īl is explicative of tilka ‘that’ in other words you have enslaved them but not me there is no favour in that for your enslavement of them is wrong some scholars have reckoned there to be an interrogative hamza of denial at the beginning of this verse a-tilka ni‘matun ‘is that a favour?’.
22.ar: ﴿وتِلْكَ نِعْمَة تَمُنّها عَلَيَّ﴾ أصْله تَمُنّ بِها عَلَيَّ ﴿أنْ عَبَّدْت بَنِي إسْرائِيل﴾ بَيان لِتِلْكَ أيْ اتَّخَذْتهمْ عَبِيدًا ولَمْ تَسْتَعْبِدنِي لا نِعْمَة لَك بِذَلِكَ لِظُلْمِك بِاسْتِعْبادِهِمْ وقَدَّرَ بَعْضهمْ أوَّل الكَلام هَمْزَة اسْتِفْهام لِلْإنْكارِ

23.en: Pharaoh said to Moses ‘And what is “the Lord of the Worlds” ’ the One Whose Messenger you say you indeed are? In other words what exactly is He? And since there is no way for creation to know the true nature of God but only to know Him through an articulation of His attributes Moses blessings and peace be upon him responds to him with mention of some of these attributes
23.ar: ﴿قالَ فِرْعَوْن﴾ لِمُوسى ﴿وما رَبّ العالَمِينَ﴾ الَّذِي قُلْت إنّك رَسُوله أيْ: أيْ شَيْء هُوَ ولَمّا لَمْ يَكُنْ سَبِيل لِلْخَلْقِ إلى مَعْرِفَة حَقِيقَته تَعالى وإنَّما يَعْرِفُونَهُ بِصِفاتِهِ أجابَهُ مُوسى عَلَيْهِ الصَّلاة والسَّلام بِبَعْضِها:

24.en: He said ‘The Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in other words the Creator of all that — should you have conviction’ that He exalted be He is their Creator then believe in Him alone.
24.ar: ﴿قالَ رَبّ السَّماوات والأَرْض وما بَيْنهما﴾ أيْ خالِق ذَلِكَ ﴿إنْ كُنْتُمْ مُوقِنِينَ﴾ بِأَنَّهُ تَعالى خالِقه فَآمِنُوا بِهِ وحْده

25.en: He Pharaoh said to those noblemen among his folk who were around him ‘Did you not hear?!’ his response how it does not correspond to the question I asked?
25.ar: ﴿قالَ﴾ فِرْعَوْن ﴿لِمَن حَوْله﴾ مِن أشْراف قَوْمه ﴿ألا تَسْتَمِعُونَ﴾ جَوابه الَّذِي لَمْ يُطابِق السُّؤال

26.en: He Moses said ‘Your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers’. Now even though this fact is comprised by what was said before it enrages Pharaoh and therefore
26.ar: ﴿قالَ﴾ مُوسى ﴿رَبّكُمْ ورَبّ آبائِكُمْ الأَوَّلِينَ﴾ وهَذا وإنْ كانَ داخِلًا فِيما قَبْله يَغِيظ فِرْعَوْن ولِذَلِكَ

27.en: He said ‘Verily this messenger of yours sent to you is a madman!’

28.en: He Moses said ‘The Lord of the east and the west and all that is between them — should you comprehend’ that He is such a Lord then believe in Him alone.
28.ar: ﴿قالَ﴾ مُوسى ﴿رَبّ المَشْرِق والمَغْرِب وما بَيْنهما إنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ﴾ أنَّهُ كَذَلِكَ فَآمِنُوا بِهِ وحْده

29.en: He Pharaoh said to Moses ‘If you choose any god other than me I will surely make you a prisoner!’. His Pharaoh’s prison was very harsh for a person would be shut up in a dungeon underground alone where he could neither see nor hear anyone else.
29.ar: ﴿قالَ﴾ فِرْعَوْن لِمُوسى ﴿لَئِنْ اتَّخَذْت إلَهًا غَيْرِي لَأَجْعَلَنك مِن المَسْجُونِينَ﴾ كانَ سِجْنه شَدِيدًا يَحْبِس الشَّخْص فِي مَكان تَحْت الأَرْض وحْده لا يُبْصِر ولا يَسْمَع فِيهِ أحَدًا

30.en: He Moses said to him ‘What would you do this even if I bring you something manifest?’ patent proof of my Mission?
30.ar: ﴿قالَ﴾ لَهُ مُوسى ﴿أوَلَوْ﴾ أيْ: أتَفْعَلُ ذَلِك ولَوْ ﴿جِئْتُك بِشَيْءٍ مُبِين﴾ بُرْهان بَيِّن عَلى رِسالَتِي

31.en: He Pharaoh said to him ‘Then bring it if you are truthful’ in this.
31.ar: ﴿قالَ﴾ فِرْعَوْن لَهُ ﴿فَأْتِ بِهِ إنْ كُنْت مِن الصّادِقِينَ﴾ فِيهِ

32.en: So he threw down his staff and lo! it was a manifest serpent a great snake.
32.ar: ﴿فَأَلْقى عَصاهُ فَإذا هِيَ ثُعْبان مُبِين﴾ حَيَّة عَظِيمَة

33.en: Then he drew out his hand he brought it out of his pocket and lo! it was white glowing before the onlookers and not its usual skin colour.
33.ar: ﴿ونَزَعَ يَده﴾ أخْرَجَها مِن جَيْبه ﴿فَإذا هِيَ بَيْضاء﴾ ذات شُعاع ﴿لِلنّاظِرِينَ﴾ خِلاف ما كانَتْ عَلَيْهِ مِن الأَدْمَة

34.en: He Pharaoh said to the council around him ‘Surely this man is a cunning sorcerer an expert in the art of magic
34.ar: ﴿قالَ﴾ فِرْعَوْن ﴿لِلْمَلَإ حَوْله إنّ هَذا لَساحِر عَلِيم﴾ فائِق فِي عِلْم السِّحْر

35.en: who seeks to expel you from your land by his sorcery. So what do you advise?’

36.en: They said ‘Put him and his brother off for a while postpone judgement of their affair and send musterers into the cities
36.ar: ﴿قالُوا أرْجِهِ وأَخاهُ﴾ أخِّرْ أمْرهما ﴿وابْعَثْ فِي المَدائِن حاشِرِينَ﴾ جامِعِينَ

37.en: to bring you every cunning sorcerer’ to surpass Moses in the art of magic.
37.ar: ﴿يَأْتُوك بِكُلِّ سَحّار عَلِيم﴾ يَفْضُل مُوسى فِي عِلْم السِّحْر

38.en: So the sorcerers were assembled at a fixed time of a known day which was the morning of the Festival Day.
38.ar: ﴿فَجُمِعَ السَّحَرَة لِمِيقاتِ يَوْم مَعْلُوم﴾ وهُوَ وقْت الضُّحى مِن يَوْم الزِّينَة

39.en: And it was said to the people ‘Will you assemble!’
39.ar: ﴿وقِيلَ لِلنّاسِ هَلْ أنْتُمْ مُجْتَمِعُونَ" الِاسْتِفْهام لِلْحَثِّ عَلى الِاجْتِماع﴾

40.en: Maybe we will follow the sorcerers should they be the victors’ the interrogative of the previous verse is an incitement to assemble and the optative sense implicit in la‘alla is due to their anticipation of victory and hence their continued adherence to their religion and rejection of Moses.
40.ar: والتَّرَجِّي عَلى تَقْدِير غَلَبَتهمْ لِيَسْتَمِرُّوا عَلى دِينهمْ فَلا يَتْبَعُوا مُوسى

41.en: So when the sorcerers came they said to Pharaoh ‘Shall we indeed read a-inna either by pronouncing both hamzas or by not pronouncing the second but in both cases inserting an alif have a reward if we were to be the victors?’
41.ar: ﴿فَلَمّا جاءَ السَّحَرَة قالُوا لِفِرْعَوْن أإنَّ﴾ بِتَحْقِيقِ الهَمْزَتَيْنِ وتَسْهِيل الثّانِيَة وإدْخال ألِف بَيْنهما عَلى الوَجْهَيْنِ

42.en: He said ‘Yes of course! And you shall then be among those closest to me’.

43.en: Moses said to them after they had said to him Either you cast or we shall be the casters Q. 7115 ‘Cast what you have to cast’ — the command to do this signifies an authorisation for them to cast and a means whereby the truth will be made to prevail.
43.ar: ﴿قالَ لَهُمْ مُوسى﴾ بَعْدَما قالُوا لَهُ ﴿إمّا أنْ تُلْقِي وإمّا أنْ نَكُون نَحْنُ المُلْقِينَ﴾ ﴿ألْقُوا ما أنْتُمْ مُلْقُونَ﴾ فالأَمْر فِيهِ لِلْإذْنِ بِتَقْدِيمِ إلْقائِهِمْ تَوَسُّلًا بِهِ إلى إظْهار الحَقّ

44.en: So they cast their ropes and their staffs and said ‘By the power of Pharaoh we shall surely be the victors!’

45.en: Thereat Moses cast his staff and lo! it was swallowing talqafu one of the original two tā’ letters of taltaqifu has been assimilated what they had faked what they had transformed through illusion making their ropes and staffs appear to be moving serpents.
45.ar: ﴿فَأَلْقى مُوسى عَصاهُ فَإذا هِيَ تَلْقَف﴾ بِحَذْفِ إحْدى التّاءَيْنِ مِن الأَصْل تَبْتَلِع ﴿ما يَأْفِكُونَ﴾ يَقْلِبُونَهُ بِتَمْوِيهِهِمْ فَيُخَيِّلُونَ حِبالهمْ وعِصِيّهمْ أنَّها حَيّات تَسْعى

46.en: So the sorcerers fell down prostrating.

47.en: They said ‘We believe in the Lord of the Worlds

48.en: the Lord of Moses and Aaron’ for they realised that what they had witnessed in the case of the staff could not have been the result of mere sorcery.
48.ar: ﴿رَبّ مُوسى وهارُونَ﴾ لِعِلْمِهِمْ بِأَنَّ ما شاهَدُوهُ مِن العَصا لا يَتَأَتّى بِالسِّحْرِ

49.en: Pharaoh said ‘Do you believe a-āmantum read pronouncing both hamzas or replacing the second one with an alif him Moses though I have not given you leave? He is indeed your chief the one who has taught you sorcery — so that he only taught you some tricks and then surpassed you with others. Soon you will know what I will do with you! I will assuredly cut off your hands and legs on opposite sides — in other words the right hand of each one together with his left leg — then I shall surely crucify you all.’
49.ar: ﴿قالَ﴾ فِرْعَوْن ﴿آمَنتُمْ﴾ بِتَحْقِيقِ الهَمْزَتَيْنِ وإبْدال الثّانِيَة ألِفًا ﴿لَهُ﴾ لِمُوسى ﴿قَبْل أنْ آذَن﴾ أنا ﴿لَكُمْ إنّهُ لَكَبِيركُمْ الَّذِي عَلَّمَكُمْ السِّحْر﴾ فَعَلَّمَكُمْ شَيْئًا مِنهُ وغَلَبَكُمْ بِآخَر ﴿فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ ما يَنالكُمْ مِنِّي ﴿لَأُقَطِّعَن أيْدِيكُمْ وأَرْجُلكُمْ مِن خِلاف﴾ أيْ يَد كُلّ واحِد اليُمْنى ورِجْله اليُسْرى

50.en: They said ‘There is no harm in that no damage will be done to us thereby. Surely to our Lord after we die whichever way that may be we shall return in the Hereafter.
50.ar: ﴿قالُوا لا ضَيْر﴾ لا ضَرَر عَلَيْنا فِي ذَلِكَ ﴿إنّا إلى رَبّنا﴾ بَعْد مَوْتنا بِأَيِّ وجْه كانَ ﴿مُنْقَلِبُونَ﴾ راجِعُونَ فِي الآخِرَة

51.en: Indeed We hope our Lord will forgive us our iniquities for being the first to believe’ in our time.
51.ar: ﴿إنّا نَطْمَع﴾ نَرْجُو ﴿أنْ يَغْفِر لَنا رَبّنا خَطايانا أنْ﴾ أيْ بِأَنْ ﴿كُنّا أوَّل المُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ فِي زَماننا

52.en: And We revealed to Moses after many years which he spent among them calling them to the truth with God’s signs but all of which only increased them in insolence saying ‘Journey with My servants the Children of Israel by night a variant reading for an asri is an isr from the verb sarā one form of asrā go with them by night in the direction of the sea for indeed you will be pursued’. Pharaoh and his armies will pursue you but when they enter the sea in pursuit of you I will deliver you and drown them.
52.ar: ﴿وأَوْحَيْنا إلى مُوسى﴾ بَعْد سِنِينَ أقامَها بَيْنهمْ يَدْعُوهُمْ بِآياتِ اللَّه إلى الحَقّ فَلَمْ يَزِيدُوا إلّا عُتُوًّا ﴿أنْ أسِرْ بِعِبادِي﴾ بَنِي إسْرائِيل وفِي قِراءَة بِكَسْرِ النُّون ووَصْل هَمْزَة أسْرِ مِن سَرى لُغَة فِي أسْرى أيْ سِرْ بِهِمْ لَيْلًا إلى البَحْر ﴿إنّكُمْ مُتَّبِعُونَ﴾ يَتْبَعكُمْ فِرْعَوْن وجُنُوده فَيَلِجُونَ وراءَكُمْ البَحْر فَأُنْجِيكُمْ وأُغْرِقهُمْ

53.en: Then Pharaoh having been informed of their night departure sent to the cities — it is said that he ruled a thousand cities and twelve thousand villages — musterers to assemble the army saying
53.ar: ﴿فَأَرْسَلَ فِرْعَوْن﴾ حِين أخْبَرَ بِسَيْرِهِمْ ﴿فِي المَدائِن﴾ قِيلَ كانَ لَهُ ألْف مَدِينَة واثْنا عَشَر ألْف قَرْيَة ﴿حاشِرِينَ﴾ جامِعِينَ الجَيْش قائِلًا

54.en: ‘Lo! these are but a small gang. It is said that they the Children of Israel numbered 670000 while his Pharaoh’s vanguard alone numbered 700000 and so he deemed their number insignificant in comparison to his huge army.
54.ar: ﴿إنّ هَؤُلاءِ لَشِرْذِمَة﴾ طائِفَة ﴿قَلِيلُونَ﴾ قِيلَ كانُوا سِتّمِائَةِ ألْف وسَبْعِينَ ألْفًا ومُقَدَّمَة جَيْشه سَبْعمِائَةِ ألْف فَقَلَّلَهُمْ بِالنَّظَرِ إلى كَثْرَة جَيْشه

55.en: And indeed they have enraged us their actions infuriate us

56.en: and indeed we are all on our guard’ ready a variant reading for hadhirūna has hādhirūn meaning ‘alert’.
56.ar: ﴿وإنّا لَجَمِيع حاذِرُونَ﴾ مُسْتَعِدُّونَ وفِي قِراءَة حاذِرُونَ مُتَيَقِّظُونَ

57.en: God exalted be He says So We made them Pharaoh and his folk go forth out of Egypt in order to pursue Moses and his people from gardens orchards on either side of the Nile and springs streams running from the Nile through their dwellings
57.ar: ﴿فَأَخْرَجْناهُمْ﴾ أيْ فِرْعَوْن وقَوْمه مِن مِصْر لِيَلْحَقُوا مُوسى وقَوْمه ﴿مِن جَنّات﴾ بَساتِين كانَتْ عَلى جانِبَيْ النِّيل ﴿وعُيُون﴾ أنْهار جارِيَة فِي الدُّور مِن النِّيل

58.en: and treasures visible riches of gold and silver — these riches are called kunūz as opposed to amwāl ‘riches’ because that portion which is always due to God exalted be He from them had not been paid — and splendid places exquisite residences for princes and ministers surrounded by their retinues.
58.ar: ﴿وكُنُوز﴾ أمْوال ظاهِرَة مِن الذَّهَب والفِضَّة، وسُمِّيَتْ كُنُوزًا لِأَنَّهُ لَمْ يُعْطِ حَقّ اللَّه تَعالى مِنها ﴿ومَقام كَرِيم﴾ مَجْلِس حَسَن لِلْأُمَراءِ والوُزَراء يَحُفّهُ أتْباعهمْ

59.en: So it was that is Our expulsion of them was as We have described and We made the Children of Israel to inherit these after drowning Pharaoh and his folk.
59.ar: ﴿كَذَلِكَ﴾ أيْ إخْراجنا كَما وصَفْنا ﴿وأَوْرَثْناها بَنِي إسْرائِيل﴾ بَعْد إغْراق فِرْعَوْن وقَوْمه:

60.en: Then they pursued them they caught them up at sunrise.

61.en: And when the two hosts sighted each other the companions of Moses said ‘We have been caught!’ Pharaoh’s hosts have caught us up and we have no power against them.
61.ar: ﴿فَلَمّا تَراءى الجَمْعانِ﴾ رَأى كُلّ مِنهُما الآخَر ﴿قالَ أصْحاب مُوسى إنّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ﴾ يُدْرِكنا جَمْع فِرْعَوْن ولا طاقَة لَنا بِهِ

62.en: He Moses said ‘Certainly not! they shall not catch us up; indeed I have my Lord with me to provide assistance. He will guide me’ to the route of deliverance.
62.ar: ﴿قالَ﴾ مُوسى ﴿كَلّا﴾ أيْ لَنْ يُدْرِكُونا ﴿إنّ مَعِيَ رَبِّي﴾ بِنَصْرِهِ ﴿سَيَهْدِينِ﴾ طَرِيق النَّجاة

63.en: God exalted be He says Thereupon We revealed to Moses ‘Strike the sea with your staff’ and he struck it whereupon it parted it split into twelve parts and each part was as a mighty mountain between each of these parts were paths which they followed such that not even the saddles or the felts of the riders were touched by water.
63.ar: ﴿فَأَوْحَيْنا إلى مُوسى أنْ اضْرِبْ بِعَصاك البَحْر﴾ فَضَرَبَهُ ﴿فانْفَلَقَ﴾ فانْشَقَّ اثْنَيْ عَشَر فِرَقًا ﴿فَكانَ كُلّ فِرْق كالطَّوْدِ العَظِيم﴾ الجَبَل الضَّخْم بَيْنهما مَسالِك سَلَكُوها لَمْ يَبْتَلّ مِنها سُرُج الرّاكِب ولا لِبْده

64.en: And there We brought near the others Pharaoh and his folk until they followed them across the same paths.
64.ar: ﴿وأَزْلَفْنا﴾ قَرَّبْنا ﴿ثَمَّ﴾ هُناكَ ﴿الآخِرِينَ﴾ فِرْعَوْن وقَوْمه حَتّى سَلَكُوا مَسالِكهمْ

65.en: And We delivered Moses and all those who were with him by bringing them out of the sea while it was in the state mentioned above.
65.ar: ﴿وأَنْجَيْنا مُوسى ومَن مَعَهُ أجْمَعِينَ﴾ بِإخْراجِهِمْ مِن البَحْر عَلى هَيْئَته المَذْكُورَة

66.en: Then We drowned the others Pharaoh and his folk by closing the sea on them after they had entered the sea and the Children of Israel had exited therefrom.
66.ar: ﴿ثُمَّ أغْرَقْنا الآخَرِينَ﴾ فِرْعَوْن وقَوْمه بِإطْباقِ البَحْر عَلَيْهِمْ لَمّا تَمَّ دُخُولهمْ فِي البَحْر وخُرُوج بَنِي إسْرائِيل مِنهُ

67.en: Surely in that drowning of Pharaoh and his folk there is a sign a lesson for those generations who would come after them; but most of them are not believers in God. The only ones to believe were Āsiya — Pharaoh’s wife — Hizqīl the believing man of Pharaoh’s family and Maryam daughter of Nāmūsī she who pointed out the bone remains of the prophet Joseph peace be upon him.
67.ar: ﴿إنّ فِي ذَلِكَ﴾ إغْراق فِرْعَوْن وقَوْمه ﴿لَآيَة﴾ عِبْرَة لِمَن بَعْدهمْ ﴿وما كانَ أكْثَرهمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ بِاللَّهِ لَمْ يُؤْمِن مِنهُمْ غَيْر آسِيَة امْرَأَة فِرْعَوْن وحزقيل مُؤْمِن آل فِرْعَوْن ومَرْيَم بِنْت ناموصي الَّتِي دَلَّتْ عَلى عِظام يُوسُف عَلَيْهِ السَّلام

68.en: And surely your Lord He is the Mighty for He wrought vengeance upon the disbelievers by drowning them the Merciful to believers delivering them from drowning.
68.ar: ﴿وإنَّ رَبّك لَهُوَ العَزِيز﴾ فانْتَقَمَ مِن الكافِرِينَ بِإغْراقِهِمْ ﴿الرَّحِيم﴾ بِالمُؤْمِنِينَ فَأَنْجاهُمْ مِن الغَرَق

69.en: And recite to them the disbelievers of Mecca the tiding the tale of Abraham Ibrāhīma is substituted by the following idh qāla ‘when he said’
69.ar: ﴿واتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ أيْ كُفّار مَكَّة ﴿نَبَأ﴾ خَبَر ﴿إبْراهِيم﴾ ويُبْدَل مِنهُ

70.en: when he said to his father and his people ‘What do you worship?’

71.en: They said ‘We worship idols — they reiterate the verb in the response in order to supplement it with the following remark — and remain cleaving to them’ we remain worshipping them all day; they give a longer response to indicate their misplaced pride in such an act.
71.ar: ﴿قالُوا نَعْبُد أصْنامًا﴾ صَرَّحُوا بِالفِعْلِ لِيَعْطِفُوا عَلَيْهِ ﴿فَنَظَلّ لَها عاكِفِينَ﴾ نُقِيم نَهارًا عَلى عِبادَتها زادُوهُ فِي الجَواب افْتِخارًا بِهِ

72.en: He said ‘Do they hear you when you supplicate?

73.en: Or do they bring you benefit when you worship them or harm? to you if you do not?
73.ar: ﴿أوْ يَنْفَعُونَكُمْ﴾ إنْ عَبَدْتُمُوهُمْ ﴿أوْ يَضُرُّونَ﴾ كُمْ إنْ لَمْ تَعْبُدُوهُمْ

74.en: They said ‘Rather we found our fathers so doing’ that is doing the same as we do.
74.ar: ﴿قالُوا بَلْ وجَدْنا آباءَنا كَذَلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ﴾ أيْ مِثْل فِعْلنا

75.en: He said ‘Have you considered what you have been worshipping

77.en: They are indeed hateful to me I do not worship them; but the Lord of the Worlds I do worship Him
77.ar: ﴿فَإنَّهُمْ عَدُوّ لِي﴾ لا أعْبُدهُمْ ﴿إلّا﴾ لَكِنْ ﴿رَبّ العالَمِينَ﴾ فَإنِّي أعْبُدهُ

78.en: He Who created me it is He Who guides me to the proper religion

79.en: and provides me with food and drink

80.en: and when I am sick it is He Who cures me;

81.en: and Who will make me die then give me life

82.en: and Who I hope will forgive me my iniquity on the Day of Judgement the Day of Requital.
82.ar: ﴿والَّذِي أطْمَع﴾ أرْجُو ﴿أنْ يَغْفِر لِي خَطِيئَتِي يَوْم الدِّين﴾ الجَزاء

83.en: My Lord! Grant me unerring judgement knowledge and unite me with the righteous the prophets.
83.ar: ﴿رَبّ هَبْ لِي حُكْمًا﴾ عِلْمًا ﴿وأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصّالِحِينَ﴾ النَّبِيِّينَ

84.en: And confer on me a worthy repute excellent praise among posterity those who will come after me up to the Day of Resurrection.
84.ar: ﴿واجْعَلْ لِي لِسان صِدْق﴾ ثَناء حَسَنًا ﴿فِي الآخِرِينَ﴾ الَّذِينَ يَأْتُونَ بَعْدِي إلى يَوْم القِيامَة

85.en: And make me among the inheritors of the Garden of Bliss among those who will be given it.
85.ar: ﴿واجْعَلْنِي مِن ورَثَة جَنَّة النَّعِيم﴾ مِمَّنْ يُعْطاها

86.en: And forgive my father for indeed he is one of those who are astray by Your relenting to him and forgiving him this was before it became clear to him Abraham that he his father was an enemy of God as mentioned in sūrat Barā’a Q. 9114.
86.ar: ﴿واغْفِرْ لِأَبِي إنّهُ كانَ مِن الضّالِّينَ﴾ بِأَنْ تَتُوب عَلَيْهِ فَتَغْفِر لَهُ وهَذا قَبْل أنْ يَتَبَيَّن لَهُ أنَّهُ عَدُوّ لِلَّهِ كَما ذُكِرَ فِي سُورَة بَراءَة

87.en: And do not disgrace me do not expose me on the day when they mankind are resurrected;

88.en: of which day God exalted be He says the following the day when neither wealth nor children will avail anyone
88.ar: قالَ تَعالى فِيهِ ﴿يَوْم لا يَنْفَع مال ولا بَنُونَ﴾ أحَدًا

89.en: except him who comes to God with a heart that is sound free from idolatry and hypocrisy — and this is the heart of the believer whom such things will avail.
89.ar: ﴿إلّا﴾ لَكِنْ ﴿مَن أتى اللَّه بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيم﴾ مِن الشِّرْك والنِّفاق وهُوَ قَلْب المُؤْمِن فَإنَّهُ يَنْفَعهُ ذَلِكَ

90.en: And Paradise will be brought near for the God-fearing and they will be able to see it

91.en: and Hell will be revealed plainly for the perverse the disbelievers.

92.en: And it will be said to them ‘Where is that which you used to worship

93.en: besides God? that is other than Him in the way of idols. Do they help you by averting from you the chastisement or do they help one another?’ by averting it from themselves? No neither!
93.ar: ﴿مِن دُون اللَّه﴾ أيْ غَيْره مِن الأَصْنام ﴿هَلْ يَنْصُرُونَكُمْ﴾ بِدَفْعِ العَذاب عَنْكُمْ ﴿أوْ يَنْتَصِرُونَ﴾ بِدَفْعِهِ عَنْ أنْفُسهمْ، لا

94.en: Then they will be hurled cast into it they and the perverse

95.en: and the hosts of Iblīs his followers and those jinn and humans who were obedient to him all together.
95.ar: ﴿وجُنُود إبْلِيس﴾ أتْباعه، ومَن أطاعَهُ مِن الجِنّ والإنْس

96.en: They the perverse shall say as they wrangle therein with those whom they used to worship
96.ar: ﴿قالُوا﴾ أيْ الغاوُونَ ﴿وهُمْ فِيها يَخْتَصِمُونَ﴾ مَعَ مَعْبُودِيهِمْ

97.en: ‘By God we had indeed in softened in place of the hardened form with its subject omitted in other words it would usually be innahu been in manifest error
97.ar: ﴿تاللَّهِ إنْ﴾ مُخَفَّفَة مِن الثَّقِيلَة واسْمها مَحْذُوف أيْ إنّهُ ﴿كُنّا لَفِي ضَلال مُبِين﴾ بَيِّن

98.en: when we equated you in worship with the Lord of the Worlds.

99.en: And it was none other than the sinners the devils or our predecessors whose example we were following that led us astray from guidance.
99.ar: ﴿وما أضَلَّنا﴾ عَنْ الهُدى ﴿إلّا المُجْرِمُونَ﴾ أيْ الشَّياطِين أوْ أوَّلُونا الَّذِينَ اقْتَدَيْنا بِهِمْ

100.en: So now we have no intercessors as the believers have in the way of angels prophets and other believers
100.ar: ﴿فَما لَنا مِن شافِعِينَ﴾ كَما لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِن المَلائِكَة والنَّبِيِّينَ والمُؤْمِنِينَ

101.en: nor any sympathetic friend who might be concerned for us.

102.en: If only we had another turn another return to this world we would have been among those who believe!’ law ‘if only’ here is for the conditional optative to which nakūna ‘we would have been’ constitutes the response.
102.ar: ﴿فَلَوْ أنَّ لَنا كَرَّة﴾ رَجْعَة إلى الدُّنْيا ﴿فَنَكُون مِن المُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ لَوْ هُنا لِلتَّمَنِّي ونَكُون جَوابه

103.en: Surely in that which is mentioned of the tale of Abraham and his people there is a sign; but most of them are not believers.
103.ar: ﴿إنّ فِي ذَلِكَ﴾ المَذْكُور مِن قِصَّة إبْراهِيم وقَوْمه

104.en: And truly your Lord He is the Mighty the Merciful.

105.en: The people of Noah denied the messengers by denying him for they all brought the same message affirming God’s Oneness; or it is because he stayed among them for so long that it was as though he was many messengers the feminine person of the verb kadhdhabat ‘denied’ governed by qawm ‘the people’ is on account of the import but it is masculine on account of its morphological form;
105.ar: ﴿كَذَّبَتْ قَوْم نُوح المُرْسَلِينَ﴾ بِتَكْذِيبِهِمْ لَهُ لِاشْتِراكِهِمْ فِي المَجِيء بِالتَّوْحِيدِ، أوْ لِأَنَّهُ لِطُولِ لُبْثه فِيهِمْ كَأَنَّهُ رُسُل وتَأْنِيث قَوْم بِاعْتِبارِ مَعْناهُ وتَذْكِيره بِاعْتِبارِ لَفْظه

106.en: when Noah their brother — their brother only in terms of lineage — said to them ‘Will you not fear? God?
106.ar: ﴿إذْ قالَ لَهُمْ أخُوهُمْ﴾ نَسَبًا ﴿نُوح ألا تَتَّقُونَ﴾ اللَّه

107.en: Truly I am a trusted messenger sent to you to deliver the Message with which I have been sent.
107.ar: ﴿إنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُول أمِين﴾ عَلى تَبْلِيغ ما أُرْسِلْت بِهِ

108.en: So fear God and obey me in what I enjoin you to of God’s Oneness and obedience to Him.
108.ar: ﴿فاتَّقُوا اللَّه وأَطِيعُونِي﴾ فِيما آمُركُمْ بِهِ مِن تَوْحِيد اللَّه وطاعَته

109.en: I do not ask of you any reward for it for delivering it; for my reward lies only with the Lord of the Worlds.
109.ar: ﴿وما أسْأَلكُمْ عَلَيْهِ﴾ عَلى تَبْلِيغه ﴿مِن أجْر إنْ﴾ ما ﴿أجْرِيَ﴾ أيْ ثَوابِي

110.en: So fear God and obey me’ — he repeats this statement for emphasis.

111.en: They said ‘Shall we believe in you in your words when it is the lowliest people who follow you?’ wa’ttaba‘aka a variant reading has wa-atbā‘uka ‘when your followers’ plural of tābi‘ ‘follower’ as a subject the riffraff such as the weavers and the shoemakers.
111.ar: ﴿قالُوا أنُؤْمِنُ﴾ نُصَدِّق ﴿لَك﴾ لِقَوْلِك ﴿واتَّبَعَك﴾ وفِي قِراءَة وأَتْباعك جَمْع تابِع مُبْتَدَأ ﴿الأَرْذَلُونَ﴾ السَّفَلَة كالحاكَةِ والأَساكِفَة

112.en: He said ‘And what do I know of what they may have been doing?

113.en: Their reckoning is only my Lord’s concern and He will requite them if only you were aware — had you known this you would not have reviled them.
113.ar: ﴿إنْ﴾ ما ﴿حِسابهمْ إلّا عَلى رَبِّي﴾ فَيُجازِيهِمْ ﴿لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ﴾ تَعْلَمُونَ ذَلِكَ ما عَبَدْتُمُوهُمْ

114.en: And I am not about to drive away the believers.

115.en: I am just a plain warner’.
115.ar: ﴿إنْ﴾ ما ﴿أنا إلّا نَذِير مُبِين﴾ بَيِّن الإنْذار

116.en: They said ‘Lo! if you do not desist O Noah from what you say to us you will assuredly be among those assailed’ with stones or curses.
116.ar: ﴿قالُوا لَئِنْ لَمْ تَنْتَهِ يا نُوح﴾ عَمّا تَقُول لَنا ﴿لَتَكُونَن مِن المَرْجُومِينَ﴾ بِالحِجارَةِ أوْ بِالشَّتْمِ

117.en: He Noah said ‘My Lord my people have denied me

118.en: so judge conclusively between me and them and deliver me and the believers who are with me’.

119.en: He exalted be He says So We delivered him and those who were with him in the laden ark the ship filled with humans animals and birds.
119.ar: ﴿فَأَنْجَيْناهُ ومَن مَعَهُ فِي الفُلْك المَشْحُون﴾ المَمْلُوء مِن النّاس والحَيَوان والطَّيْر

120.en: Then afterwards after We delivered them We drowned the rest of his people.
120.ar: ﴿ثُمَّ أغْرَقْنا بَعْد﴾ بَعْد إنْجائِهِمْ ﴿الباقِينَ﴾ مِن قَوْمه

121.en: Surely in that there is a sign; but most of them are not believers.

122.en: Truly your Lord He is the Mighty the Merciful.

124.en: when Hūd their brother said to them ‘Will you not fear God?

125.en: Truly I am a trusted messenger sent to you.

126.en: So fear God and obey me.

127.en: I do not ask of you any reward for this; for my reward lies only with the Lord of the Worlds.
127.ar: ﴿وما أسْأَلكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِن أجْر إنْ﴾ ما

128.en: Do you build on every prominence every high place a monument an edifice as a signpost for passers-by so that you may hurl abuse? at those who pass by you and deride them ta‘bathūna is a circumstantial qualifier referring to the subject of the verb tabnūna ‘you build’.
128.ar: ﴿أتَبْنُونَ بِكُلِّ رِيع﴾ مَكان مُرْتَفِع ﴿آيَة﴾ بِناء عَلَمًا لِلْمارَّةِ ﴿تَعْبَثُونَ﴾ بِمَن يَمُرّ بِكُمْ وتَسْخَرُونَ مِنهُمْ والجُمْلَة حال فِي ضَمِير تَبْنُونَ

129.en: And you set up structures for extracting water underground that perhaps you might as though you will last forever therein and not die.
129.ar: ﴿وتَتَّخِذُونَ مَصانِع﴾ لِلْماءِ تَحْت الأَرْض ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ﴾ كَأَنَّكُمْ ﴿تَخْلُدُونَ﴾ فِيها لا تَمُوتُونَ

130.en: And when you assault to smite or slay you assault like tyrants mercilessly!
130.ar: ﴿وإذا بَطَشْتُمْ﴾ بِضَرْبٍ أوْ قَتْل ﴿بَطَشْتُمْ جَبّارِينَ﴾ مِن غَيْر رَأْفَة

131.en: So fear God in this and obey me in what I have commanded you.
131.ar: ﴿فاتَّقُوا اللَّه﴾ فِي ذَلِكَ ﴿وأَطِيعُونِ﴾ فِيما أمَرْتُكُمْ بِهِ

132.en: And fear Him Who has provided you Who has been gracious to you in a way that you know

133.en: provided you with cattle and sons

134.en: and gardens orchards and springs rivers.

135.en: Indeed I fear for you the chastisement of a tremendous day’ in this world and in the Hereafter should you disobey me.
135.ar: ﴿إنِّي أخاف عَلَيْكُمْ عَذاب يَوْم عَظِيم﴾ فِي الدُّنْيا والآخِرَة إنْ عَصَيْتُمُونِي

136.en: They said ‘It is the same to us whether you admonish us or are not one of those who admonish anyway. In other words we will not heed your admonition.
136.ar: ﴿قالُوا سَواء عَلَيْنا﴾ مُسْتَوٍ عِنْدنا ﴿أوَعَظْت أمْ لَمْ تَكُنْ مِن الواعِظِينَ﴾ أصْلًا أيْ لا نَرْعَوِي لِوَعْظِك

137.en: This that you threaten us with is merely the fabrication of the ancients that is their inventions and lies a variant reading for khalq ‘fabrication’ is khuluq ‘ethos’ in other words this denial of resurrection to which we adhere is merely ‘the ethos of the ancients’ in other words their nature and wont;
137.ar: ﴿إنْ﴾ ما ﴿هَذا﴾ الَّذِي خَوَّفْتنا بِهِ ﴿إلّا خُلُق الأَوَّلِينَ﴾ اخْتِلاقهمْ وكَذِبهمْ وفِي قِراءَة بِضَمِّ الخاء واللّام أيْ ما هَذا الَّذِي نَحْنُ عَلَيْهِ مِن إنْكار لِلْبَعْثِ إلّا خَلْق الأَوَّلِينَ أيْ طَبِيعَتهمْ وعادَتهمْ

138.en: and we will not be chastised’.

139.en: So they denied him concerning the chastisement whereupon We destroyed them in this world with the barren wind cf. Q. 5141. Surely in that there is a sign; but most of them are not believers.

140.en: Truly your Lord He is the Mighty the Merciful.

142.en: when Sālih their brother said to them ‘Will you fear God?

143.en: Truly I am a trusted messenger sent to you.

144.en: So fear God and obey me.

145.en: I do not ask of you any reward for this; for my reward lies only with the Lord of the Worlds.
145.ar: ﴿وما أسْأَلكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِن أجْر إنْ﴾ ما

146.en: Will you be left secure in that which is here of good things —

148.en: and farms and date palms with slender delicate and tender spathes?

149.en: And you hew dwellings out of the mountains arrogantly a variant reading of farihīna ‘arrogant’ has fārihīn ‘skilfully’.
149.ar: ﴿وتَنْحِتُونَ مِن الجِبال بُيُوتًا فارِهِينَ﴾ بَطِرِينَ وفِي قِراءَة فارِهِينَ حاذِقِينَ

150.en: So fear God and obey me in what I have commanded you

151.en: and do not obey the command of the prodigal

152.en: who cause corruption in the earth through acts of disobedience and act righteously’ by being obedient to God.
152.ar: ﴿الَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِي الأَرْض﴾ بِالمَعاصِي ﴿ولا يُصْلِحُونَ﴾ بِطاعَةِ اللَّه

153.en: They said ‘You are indeed one of the bewitched those who have succumbed so many times to sorcery that their minds have been overcome.
153.ar: ﴿قالُوا إنّما أنْتَ مِن المُسَحَّرِينَ﴾ الَّذِينَ سَحَرُوا كَثِيرًا حَتّى غَلَبَ عَلى عَقْلهمْ

154.en: And moreover you are just a human being like us. So bring us a sign if you are sincere’ in your Mission.
154.ar: ﴿ما أنْتَ﴾ أيْضًا ﴿إلّا بَشَر مِثْلنا فَأْتِ بِآيَةٍ إنْ كُنْت مِن الصّادِقِينَ﴾ فِي رِسالَتك

155.en: He said ‘This is a she-camel; she shall drink a share of the water and you shall drink each on a known day.
155.ar: ﴿قالَ هَذِهِ ناقَة لَها شِرْب﴾ نَصِيب مِن الماء

156.en: And do not cause her any harm for then you shall be seized by the chastisement of an awful day’ awful because of the awfulness of the chastisement.
156.ar: ﴿ولا تَمَسُّوها بِسُوءٍ فَيَأْخُذكُمْ عَذاب يَوْم عَظِيم﴾ بِعِظَمِ العَذاب

157.en: But they hamstrung her — a group of them hamstrung her with the approval of others; and then became remorseful for having hamstrung it.
157.ar: ﴿فَعَقَرُوها﴾ عَقَرَها بَعْضهمْ بِرِضاهُمْ ﴿فَأَصْبَحُوا نادِمِينَ﴾ عَلى عَقْرها

158.en: So they were seized by the chastisement which had been promised and were destroyed. Surely in that there is a sign; but most of them are not believers.

159.en: Truly your Lord He is the Mighty the Merciful.

160.en: The people of Lot denied the messengers

161.en: when Lot their brother said to them ‘Will you not fear God?

162.en: Truly I am a trusted messenger sent to you.

163.en: So fear God and obey me.

164.en: I do not ask of you any reward for this; my reward lies only with the Lord of the Worlds.
164.ar: ﴿وما أسْأَلكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِن أجْر إنْ﴾ ما

165.en: What! Of all people you come unto males to fornicate

166.en: and forsake the wives your Lord has created for you? in other words you forsake intimacy with their front parts? Nay but you are a transgressing folk’ overstepping the bounds of what is lawful into what is unlawful.
166.ar: ﴿وتَذَرُونَ ما خَلَقَ لَكُمْ رَبّكُمْ مِن أزْواجكُمْ﴾ أيْ أقْبالهنَّ ﴿بَلْ أنْتُمْ قَوْم عادُونَ﴾ مُتَجاوِزُونَ الحَلال إلى الحَرام

167.en: They said ‘If you do not desist O Lot from reproaching us you will assuredly be of those expelled’ from our land.
167.ar: ﴿قالُوا لَئِنْ لَمْ تَنْتَهِ يا لُوط﴾ عَنْ إنْكارك عَلَيْنا ﴿لَتَكُونَن مِن المُخْرَجِينَ﴾ مِن بَلْدَتنا

168.en: He Lot said ‘Truly I abhor I detest what you do.

169.en: My Lord deliver me and my family from what they do’ that is from the punishment for it.
169.ar: ﴿رَبّ نَجِّنِي وأَهْلِي مِمّا يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ أيْ مِن عَذابه

170.en: So We delivered him and all his family

171.en: except an old woman — his wife — among those who stayed behind whom We destroyed.

172.en: Then We destroyed all the others

173.en: and We rained on them a rain We rained on them stones — this detail pertains to the previous statement concerning their destruction — and evil was their rain the rain of those who were warned!
173.ar: ﴿وأَمْطَرْنا عَلَيْهِمْ مَطَرًا﴾ حِجارَة مِن جُمْلَة الإهْلاك ﴿فَساءَ مَطَر المُنْذَرِينَ﴾ مَطَرهمْ

174.en: Surely in that there is a sign; but most of them are not believers.

175.en: Surely your Lord He is the Mighty the Merciful.

176.en: The dwellers in the wood a variant reading for ashābu’l-aykati has ashābu laykata a thicket of trees near Midian denied the messengers
176.ar: ﴿كَذَّبَ أصْحاب الأَيْكَة﴾ وفِي قِراءَة بِحَذْفِ الهَمْزَة وإلْقاء حَرَكَتها عَلى اللّام وفَتْح الهاء: هِيَ غَيْضَة شَجَر قُرْب مَدْيَن

177.en: when Shu‘ayb — He God does not say ‘their brother’ in this instance because he Shu‘ayb was not in terms of lineage one of them — said to them ‘Will you not fear God?
177.ar: ﴿إذْ قالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْب﴾ لَمْ يَقُلْ أخُوهُمْ لِأَنَّهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ مِنهُمْ

178.en: Truly I am a trusted messenger sent to you.

179.en: So fear God and obey me.

180.en: I do not ask of you any reward for this; indeed my reward lies only with the Lord of the Worlds.
180.ar: ﴿وما أسْأَلكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِن أجْر إنْ﴾ ما

181.en: Give full measure and do not be of those who give short measure
181.ar: ﴿أوْفُوا الكَيْل﴾ أتِمُّوهُ ﴿ولا تَكُونُوا مِن المُخْسِرِينَ﴾ النّاقِصِينَ

182.en: and weigh with an even balance

183.en: and do not defraud people in their goods do not diminish anything of what is due to them and do not be degenerate in the earth seeking corruption by killing or otherwise ta‘thaw ‘degenerate’ derives from ‘athiya meaning afsada ‘to corrupt’; mufsidīna ‘seeking corruption’ is a circumstantial qualifier emphasising the import of its operator ta‘thaw.
183.ar: ﴿ولا تَبْخَسُوا النّاس أشْياءَهُمْ﴾ لا تُنْقِصُوهُمْ مِن حَقّهمْ شَيْئًا ﴿ولا تَعْثَوْا فِي الأَرْض مُفْسِدِينَ﴾ بِالقَتْلِ وغَيْره مِن عَثِيَ بِكَسْرِ المُثَلَّثَة أفْسَدَ ومُفْسِدِينَ حال مُؤَكِّدَة لِمَعْنى عامِلها

184.en: And fear Him Who created you and the former generations’ all creation before you.

185.en: They said ‘You are indeed one of the bewitched.

186.en: You are just a human being like us. And we indeed in softened in place of the hardened form its subject omitted in other words it would be innahu think that you are one of the liars.
186.ar: ﴿وما أنْتَ إلّا بَشَر مِثْلنا وإنْ﴾ مُخَفَّفَة مِن الثَّقِيلَة واسْمها مَحْذُوف أيْ إنّهُ

187.en: Then make fragments read kisfan or kisafan of the heaven fall upon us if you are of the truthful’ in your Mission.
187.ar: ﴿فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنا كِسَفًا﴾ بِسُكُونِ السِّين وفَتْحها قِطَعًا ﴿مِن السَّماء إنْ كُنْت مِن الصّادِقِينَ﴾ فِي رِسالَتك

188.en: He said ‘My Lord knows best what you are doing’ and will requite you for it.
188.ar: ﴿قالَ رَبِّي أعْلَم بِما تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ فَيُجازِيكُمْ بِهِ

189.en: But they denied him so they were seized by the chastisement of the day of the shade al-zulla — a cloud which gave them shade when they suffered a bout of extreme heat but which then rained down fire on them and they were incinerated. Assuredly it was the chastisement of a tremendous day.
189.ar: ﴿فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذاب يَوْم الظُّلَّة﴾ هِيَ سَحابَة أظَلَّتْهُمْ بَعْد حَرّ شَدِيد أصابَهُمْ فَأَمْطَرَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ نارًا فاحْتَرَقُوا

190.en: Surely in that there is a sign; but most of them are not believers.

191.en: Surely your Lord He is the Mighty the Merciful.

192.en: Truly it the Qur’ān is the revelation of the Lord of the Worlds

193.en: brought down by the Trustworthy Spirit Gabriel

194.en: upon your heart that you may be one of the warners

195.en: in a clear Arabic tongue a variant reading for nazala ‘he brought down’ verse 193 has nuzzila ‘was sent down’ and al-rūha ‘the Spirit’ in the accusative the subject of the verb being God.
195.ar: ﴿بِلِسانٍ عَرَبِيّ مُبِين﴾ بَيِّن وفِي قِراءَة بِتَشْدِيدِ نَزَلَ ونَصْب الرُّوح والفاعِل اللَّه

196.en: And truly it the allusion to the Qur’ān that would be revealed to Muhammad (s) is in the Scriptures the Books of the ancients such as the Torah and the Gospel.
196.ar: ﴿وإنَّهُ﴾ ذِكْر القُرْآن المُنَزَّل عَلى مُحَمَّد ﴿لَفِي زُبُر﴾ كُتُب ﴿الأَوَّلِينَ﴾ كالتَّوْراةِ والإنْجِيل

197.en: Is it not a sign of this fact for them for the disbelievers of Mecca that the learned of the Children of Israel recognise it? those such as ‘Abd Allāh b. Salām and his companions from among those who became Muslim believers they are able inform you of this read yakun with āyatan in the accusative or takun with āyatun in the nominative.
197.ar: ﴿أوَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُمْ﴾ لِكُفّارِ مَكَّة ﴿آيَة﴾ عَلى ذَلِكَ ويَكُنْ بالتحتانية ونَصْب آيَة وبالفوقانية ورَفْع آيَة ﴿أنْ يَعْلَمهُ عُلَماء بَنِي إسْرائِيل﴾ كَعَبْدِ اللَّه بْن سَلام وأَصْحابه مِن الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا يُخْبِرُونَ بِذَلِكَ

198.en: For had We revealed it to some non-Arabs a‘jamūn is the plural of a‘jam
198.ar: ﴿ولَوْ نَزَّلْناهُ عَلى بَعْض الأَعْجَمِينَ﴾ جَمْع أعْجَم

199.en: and had he recited it to them that is to the disbelievers of Mecca they would not have believed in it disdaining to follow it.
199.ar: ﴿فَقَرَأَهُ عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ كُفّار مَكَّة ﴿ما كانُوا بِهِ مُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ أنَفَة مِن اتِّباعه

200.en: So in the same way in which We would have caused denial of it to penetrate the hearts of disbelievers had it been recited by a non-Arab We have caused denial of it to penetrate the hearts of the criminals the Meccan disbelievers when Muhammad (s) recites it.
200.ar: ﴿كَذَلِكَ﴾ أيْ مِثْل إدْخالنا التَّكْذِيب بِهِ بِقِراءَةِ الأَعْجَمِيّ ﴿سَلَكْناهُ﴾ أدْخَلْنا التَّكْذِيب بِهِ ﴿فِي قُلُوب المُجْرِمِينَ﴾ كُفّار مَكَّة بِقِراءَةِ النَّبِيّ

201.en: They will not believe in it until they behold the painful chastisement

202.en: so that it will come upon them suddenly while they are not aware.

203.en: Thereupon they will say ‘Shall we be granted any respite?’ that we might become believers?; and it shall be said to them ‘No!’ and they will say ‘When will this chastisement be?’ God exalted be He says
203.ar: ﴿فَيَقُولُوا هَلْ نَحْنُ مُنْظَرُونَ﴾ لِنُؤْمِن فَيُقال لَهُمْ: لا، قالُوا: مَتى هَذا العَذاب

204.en: So do they seek to hasten Our chastisement?

205.en: Consider this then — inform Me If We were to let them enjoy life for many years

206.en: then there were to come on them that which they have been promised of chastisement
206.ar: ﴿ثُمَّ جاءَهُمْ ما كانُوا يُوعَدُونَ﴾ مِن العَذاب

207.en: in what way mā here is interrogative would that enjoyment which they were given avail them? in averting the chastisement or mitigating it? It would be of no avail!
207.ar: ﴿ما﴾ اسْتِفْهامِيَّة بِمَعْنى: أيّ شَيْء ﴿أغْنى عَنْهُمْ ما كانُوا يُمَتَّعُونَ﴾ فِي دَفْع العَذاب أوْ تَخْفِيفه أيْ: لَمْ يُغْنِ

208.en: And We have not destroyed any town but it had warners messengers to warn its inhabitants;
208.ar: ﴿وما أهْلَكْنا مِن قَرْيَة إلّا لَها مُنْذِرُونَ﴾ رُسُل تُنْذِر أهْلها

209.en: as a reminder an admonition for them; for We were never unjust for We destroy them only after they have been warned. The following was revealed to refute what the idolaters were saying
209.ar: ﴿ذِكْرى﴾ عِظَة لَهُمْ ﴿وما كُنّا ظالِمِينَ﴾ فِي إهْلاكهمْ بَعْد إنْذارهمْ ونَزَلَ رَدًّا لِقَوْلِ المُشْرِكِينَ

210.en: It the Qur’ān has not been brought down by the devils.

211.en: Neither would it behove befit them to bring it down nor are they capable of doing that.
211.ar: ﴿وما يَنْبَغِي﴾ يَصْلُح ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ أنْ يَنْزِلُوا بِهِ ﴿وما يَسْتَطِيعُونَ﴾ ذَلِكَ

212.en: Truly they are barred restrained with blazing stars from the hearing of the sayings of the angels.

213.en: So do not invoke any other god with God lest you be among the chastised — if you were to do what they call you to.
213.ar: ﴿فَلا تَدْعُ مَعَ اللَّه إلَهًا آخَر فَتَكُون مِن المُعَذَّبِينَ﴾ إنْ فَعَلْت ذَلِكَ الَّذِي دَعَوْك إلَيْهِ

214.en: And warn the nearest of your kinsfolk namely the Banū Hāshim and the Banū al-Muttalib ‘He the Prophet warned them publicly …’ as reported by al-Bukhārī and Muslim.
214.ar: ﴿وأَنْذِرْ عَشِيرَتك الأَقْرَبِينَ﴾ وهُمْ بَنُو هاشِم وبَنُو المُطَّلِب "وقَدْ أنْذَرَهُمْ جَهارًا" رَواهُ البُخارِيّ ومُسْلِم

215.en: And lower your wing show your gentle side to the believers the affirmers of God’s Oneness who follow you.
215.ar: ﴿واخْفِضْ جَناحك﴾ ألِنْ جانِبك ﴿لِمَن اتَّبَعَك مِن المُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ المُوَحِّدِينَ

216.en: But if they your kinsfolk disobey you say to them ‘I am absolved of what you do’ in worshipping gods other than God.
216.ar: ﴿فَإنْ عَصَوْك﴾ عَشِيرَتك ﴿فَقُلْ﴾ لَهُمْ ﴿إنِّي بَرِيء مِمّا تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ مِن عِبادَة غَيْر اللَّه

217.en: And put your trust wa-tawakkal or read fa-tawakkal ‘then put your trust’ in the Mighty the Merciful God in other words entrust Him with all your affairs
217.ar: ﴿وتَوَكَّلْ﴾ بِالواوِ والفاء ﴿عَلى العَزِيز الرَّحِيم﴾ اللَّه أيْ فَوَّضَ إلَيْهِ جَمِيع أُمُورك

218.en: Who sees you when you stand for prayer

219.en: and your movements — in performing the various parts of prayer standing sitting bowing and prostrating — among those who prostrate those who perform the prayers.
219.ar: ﴿وتَقَلُّبك﴾ فِي أرْكان الصَّلاة قائِمًا وقاعِدًا وراكِعًا وساجِدًا ﴿فِي السّاجِدِينَ﴾ المُصَلِّينَ

220.en: Truly He is the Hearing the Knowing.

221.en: Shall I inform you O disbelievers of Mecca upon whom the devils descend? tanazzalu one of the tā’ letters in the original tatanazzalu has been omitted.
221.ar: ﴿هَلْ أُنَبِّئكُمْ﴾ يا كُفّار مَكَّة ﴿عَلى مَن تَنَزَّل الشَّياطِين﴾ بِحَذْفِ إحْدى التّاءَيْنِ مِن الأَصْل

222.en: They descend upon every sinful profligate liar such as Musaylama and other soothsayers.
222.ar: ﴿تَنَزَّل عَلى كُلّ أفّاك﴾ كَذّاب ﴿أثِيم﴾ فاجِر مِثْل مُسَيْلِمَة وغَيْره مِن الكَهَنَة

223.en: They the devils report the heard sayings what they hear from the angels they report to the soothsayers but most of them are liars adding much that is false to what they hear — this was revealed before the devils were barred from the heaven.
223.ar: ﴿يُلْقُونَ﴾ الشَّياطِين ﴿السَّمْع﴾ ما سَمِعُوهُ مِن المَلائِكَة إلى الكَهَنَة ﴿وأَكْثَرهمْ كاذِبُونَ﴾ يَضُمُّونَ إلى المَسْمُوع كَذِبًا كَثِيرًا وكانَ هَذا قَبْل أنْ حُجِبَتْ الشَّياطِين عَنْ السَّماء

224.en: As for the poets only the perverse follow them in their poetry propounding it and reciting it on their behalf to others; they are thus reprehensible.
224.ar: ﴿والشُّعَراء يَتَّبِعهُمْ الغاوُونَ﴾ فِي شِعْرهمْ فَيَقُولُونَ بِهِ ويَرْوُونَهُ عَنْهُمْ فَهُمْ مَذْمُومُونَ

225.en: Have you not noticed that — are you not aware that — in every valley of the valleys of rhetoric and the art thereof they rove overstepping the bounds of decency in their eulogies and diatribes
225.ar: ﴿ألَمْ تَرَ﴾ تَعْلَم ﴿أنَّهُمْ فِي كُلّ وادٍ﴾ مِن أوْدِيَة الكَلام وفُنُونه ﴿يَهِيمُونَ﴾ يَمْضُونَ فَيُجاوِزُونَ الحَدّ مَدْحًا وهِجاء

226.en: and that they say we do what they do not do? in other words that they lie.

227.en: Save those poets who believe and perform righteous deeds and remember God frequently in other words those whom poetry does not distract from the remembrance of God and vindicate themselves by lampooning the disbelievers after they have been wronged by the disbelievers’ reviling of them as belonging together with all believers — such individuals are not reprehensible. God exalted be He says God does not like the utterance of evil words out loud unless a person has been wronged Q. 4148; He exalted be He also says so whoever commits aggression against you commit aggression against him in the manner that he committed against you Q. 2194; and those poets and others who are wrongdoers will soon know the reversal the return with which they will meet by which they will return after death.
227.ar: ﴿إلّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وعَمِلُوا الصّالِحات﴾ مِن الشُّعَراء ﴿وذَكَرُوا اللَّه كَثِيرًا﴾ لَمْ يَشْغَلهُمْ الشِّعْر عَنْ الذِّكْر ﴿وانْتَصَرُوا﴾ بِهَجْوِهِمْ الكُفّار ﴿مِن بَعْد ما ظُلِمُوا﴾ بِهَجْوِ الكُفّار لَهُمْ فِي جُمْلَة المُؤْمِنِينَ فَلَيْسُوا مَذْمُومِينَ قالَ اللَّه تَعالى: ﴿لا يُحِبّ اللَّه الجَهْر بِالسُّوءِ مِن القَوْل إلّا مَن ظُلِمَ﴾ وقالَ تَعالى: ﴿فَمَن اعْتَدى عَلَيْكُمْ فاعْتَدُوا عَلَيْهِ بِمِثْلِ ما اعْتَدى عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ ﴿وسَيَعْلَمُ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا﴾ مِن الشُّعَراء وغَيْرهمْ ﴿أيّ مُنْقَلَب﴾ مَرْجِع ﴿يَنْقَلِبُونَ﴾ يَرْجِعُونَ بَعْد المَوْت
